dogecoin.text: According to Dogecoin investor and crypto KOL Matt Wallace, Buterin has donated more than $1 million worth of  #ETH to the Dogecoin Foundation. In this regard, Dogecoin founders Billy Markus and Buterin have not yet responded. #Cryptocurrency #ETH

Solana NFT marketplace DeepRedSky has announced that it accepts Bitcoin ( #BTC ), Solana ( #SOL ) and Dogecoin ( #DOGE ) to buy #NFTs, with plans to add Ethereum ( #ETH ) and other cryptocurrencies this summer. #Cryptocurrency
